blogs.title: From Preferences to Power Moves: Why Direct Preference Optimization Is a Game Changer
blogs.description: A plain‑language walkthrough of DPO’s central idea—converting human preference pairs into a single cross‑entropy loss that updates an LLM directly, without the messy reinforcement loop.

blogs.title: Mindful Machines: Hiding Reward Models Inside Language Models
blogs.description: Explores the theory that any language model can act as a reward model through log‐ratio reparameterization, uniting policy learning and preference modeling in one elegant framework.

blogs.title: Smarter Summaries & Sentiment Control—DPO Outperforms PPO in Practice
blogs.description: Highlights real‑world experiments where DPO beats PPO on summarization, dialogue, and sentiment tasks while using far fewer hyper‑parameters and no sampling during training.

blogs.title: Cutting Through RLHF Complexity—One Loss Makes Alignment Simpler
blogs.description: Shows how DPO replaces the entire RLHF pipeline—reward fitting plus policy exploration—with a lightweight supervised step that is stable, fast, and easier for developers.

blogs.title: Beyond Dialogues: Scaling Direct Preference Optimization Won’t Stop Here
blogs.description: Speculates on scaling DPO to massive models, applying it across modalities, and what this means for safer AI alignment research moving forward.
